findings.original: the reproduction of capital on a progressively increasing scale
findings.rewrite: the reproduction of capital on a progressively increasing scale
findings.problem: Glossary §3.1 renders "reproduction on a progressive / extended scale" as "reproduction on an extended scale", which the same chapter uses in p029 and ch24-s3 p073.
findings.fix: Seen concretely, accumulation comes down to the reproduction of capital on an extended scale.

notes_review: The logged calls are sound: keeping the probably wrong £2,000 gross-product figure and "into money" in p029 as printed, rendering "aliquot part" as "fractional part" to avoid an equal-shares claim, keeping the four "insofar as" conditions in one sentence, and leaving the commodity-producer's view in p030 untagged as Marx does are all correct.
summary: Fidelity is high: the spinner arithmetic, the dialectical reversal of the laws of appropriation, the Sismondi interjections and the free indirect speech of p030 are all preserved. The many first-use §7 explanations make p002 heavy, but the text is otherwise plain and clear.
